jobs.occupation: Stipendiat i økonomi og finans
jobs.description:
Om stillingen
Universitetet i Stavanger har ledig inntil tre stipendiatstillinger innen samfunnsøkonomi eller finans ved Handelshøgskolen UiS, Avdeling for samfunnsøkonomi og finans. Stillingene er ledige fra 1. september 2027.

Stipendiatstillingen leder fram til doktorgrad og gir deg mulighet til å utvikle forskningskompetanse i et aktivt og stimulerende fagmiljø. Gjennom doktorgradsutdanningen opparbeider du kunnskap, ferdigheter og erfaring som kvalifiserer for videre karriere innenfor forskning, høyere utdanning og andre kunnskapsintensive sektorer.

De som ansettes tas opp på doktorgradsprogrammet i samfunnsøkonomi. Programmet omfatter blant annet selvstendig forskningsarbeid, deltakelse i nasjonale og internasjonale forskermiljø samt forskningsformidling. Les mer om forskerutdanningen ved UiS på våre nettsider.
 
Stillingene er for tre år med ren forskerutdanning eller fire år med forskerutdanning kombinert med annet karrierefremmende arbeid. Dette avklares i rekrutteringsprosessen.

Som stipendiat ved UiS får du støtte til faglig og karrieremessig utvikling gjennom veiledning, kompetanseutvikling og karriereplanlegging.
Forskningstema
Kandidater som ønsker å forske innenfor de områdene i økonomi og finans som er beskrevet nedenfor, oppfordres til å søke. Dette er fagfelt der avdelingen har sterk forskningskompetanse og god veiledningskapasitet. Avdelingen har en sterk vektlegging av empirisk og eksperimentell forskning, med kompetanse som spenner over flere områder innen økonomi og finans. Forskningen innen finans omfatter 

• eksperimentell finans
• prising av finansielle aktiva (asset pricing)
• markedsmikrostruktur
• eierstyring og selskapsledelse (corporate governance).
Innen samfunnsøkonomi omfatter forskningen 

• empirisk og kvantitativ analyse av internasjonal handel, energimarkeder og miljø
• store sosioøkonomiske spørreundersøkelser og eksperimenter om befolkningens preferanser for klima-, natur- og forurensningspolitikk
• felteksperimenter innen arbeids- og utdanningsøkonomi
Én av stipendiatstillingene vil være tilknyttet Synapse Lab. Kandidater som er interessert i denne stillingen, bør angi dette i søknaden og kort forklare hvordan deres forskningsinteresser samsvarer med labens forskningsaktiviteter.

Vi oppfordrer deg til å utforske avdelingens forskningsgrupper  og pågående prosjekter for inspirasjon. 
Prosjektskisse
Som en del av søknaden ber vi deg å inkludere en kort personlig beskrivelse på engelsk der du redegjør for dine planer for doktorgradsstudiet, karrieremål og forskningsinteresser, inkluder mulige forskningsideer. Du kan også nevne faglig ansatte ved Avdeling for samfunnsøkonomi og finans som du ønsker å samarbeide med dersom du blir tatt opp på ph.d.-programmet. Denne beskrivelsen er ikke en fullstendig prosjektbeskrivelse, men vil hjelpe oss til å forstå din motivasjon og faglig retning.

Dersom du blir ansatt, vil prosjektskissen og prosjektets framdriftsplan videreutvikles i samarbeid med veilederne i løpet av de tre første månedene av ansettelsesperioden og danne grunnlag for den endelige planen for doktorgradsprosjektet. 
Kvalifikasjoner
Du må ha en sterk faglig bakgrunn med femårig mastergrad innenfor økonomi eller finans eller tilsvarende utdanning som gir grunnlag for å gjennomføre en forskerutdanning, fortrinnsvis av nyere dato.

Karakter på masteroppgaven og veid gjennomsnittskarakter for masterstudiet må begge tilsvare B eller bedre. 

Dersom du har utdanning fra en institusjon med annen karakterskala enn A-F, ber vi deg legge ved dokumentasjon som viser hvordan karakterene kan sammenliknes med den norske karakterskalaen. Du kan bruke disse konverteringsskalaene til å beregne poengene dine for opptak.

Dersom du fullfører mastergraden våren 2027, er du også velkommen til å søke.
 
Vi legger også vekt på at du:

• har solide kvantitative og metodiske ferdigheter som er relevante for forskning innen samfunnsøkonomi eller finans, for eksempel innen økonometri, anvendt statistikk eller analytisk modellering
• er motivert for å forske og har potensial som forsker innen fagområdet
• har faglige og personlige forutsetninger for å fullføre doktorgraden innenfor den fastsatte tidsrammen
• tenker nytt og kreativt
• arbeider effektivt både selvstendig og i samarbeid med andre forskere
• viser høy faglig integritet og legger stor vekt på kvalitet i arbeidet ditt
• arbeider strukturert og kan håndtere stor arbeidsmengde
• behersker engelsk godt, både skriftlig og muntligKrav til engelskkunnskaper
Gode ferdigheter i engelsk, både skriftlig og muntlig, er en forutsetning for opptak til doktorgradsprogrammet. 

Dersom du er internasjonal søker og ikke omfattes av fritaksordningene nedenfor, må du dokumentere engelskkunnskapene dine med et gyldig resultat fra én av følgende språktester:

• TOEFL – Test of English as a Foreign Language, Internet-Based Test (IBT). Minimum resultat: 90/4.5
• IELTS – International English Language Testing Service. Minimum resultat: 6.5
• Certificate in Advanced English (CAE) eller Certificate of Proficiency in English (CPE) fra Universitetet i Cambridge
• PTE Academic – Pearson Test of English Academic. Minimum resultat: 62
Du er fritatt fra kravet dersom du:

• har fullført minst ett års universitetsstudier i Australia, Canada, Irland, New Zealand, Storbritannia eller USA
• har fullført en mastergrad med engelsk som undervisningsspråk i et EU-/EØS-land eller i India
• er fritatt i henhold til HK-dirs GSU liste
• ikke inngår i de ovennevnte unntakskategoriene, men har bodd i Norge de siste fem åreneSom stipendiat ved UiS får du
• forskerutdanning ved et universitet med et viktig samfunnsoppdrag
• et ambisiøst og inkluderende forskningsmiljø
• veiledning og støtte til faglig og karrieremessig utvikling
• gratis norskkurs dersom du ikke behersker norsk, svensk eller dansk på minimum A2-nivå ved ansettelse
• tilgang til Lifekeys, en digital tjeneste for mental helse og livskvalitet
• lønn som stipendiat etter Statens lønnsregulativ i stillingskode 1017, kr 580.000 brutto pr år, med lønnsutvikling etter ansiennitet i stillingen. 
• medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse med gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger
Les mer om ansattgoder og fordeler på uis.no.
Mangfold og inkludering
Mangfold er en styrke ved universitetet. Ulike erfaringer, perspektiver og bakgrunner bidrar til bedre løsninger og et godt arbeids- og læringsmiljø. Vi ønsker søkere med ulike kvalifikasjoner, livserfaringer og perspektiver, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke, uavhengig av kjønn, alder, funksjonsevne, kulturell bakgrunn eller om du har hatt opphold i arbeidslivet. UiS legger til rette for ansatte i ulike livsfaser og for medarbeidere med behov for individuell tilrettelegging. 
 
I tråd med gjeldende regelverk vil minst én kvalifisert søker med funksjonsnedsettelse, hull i CV-en eller innvandrerbakgrunn bli invitert til intervju. Dersom dette gjelder deg, kan du oppgi det i jobbsøkerportalen. Les mer om ordningen her.  
Slik søker du
Søk stillingen ved å klikke på "Søk stillingen" på denne siden. 

I Jobbnorge registrerer du søknad, relevant utdanning og arbeidserfaring samt språkferdigheter. I søknaden ber vi deg beskrive dine forskningsinteresser, din motivasjon for stillingen og hvordan din bakgrunn er relevant for forskningsprosjektet.

Følgende dokumentasjon skal lastes opp som vedlegg til søknaden:

• en kort personlig redegjørelse der du beskriver planene dine for doktorgradsstudiet, karrieremålene dine og forskningsinteressene dine
• CV med fullstendig oversikt over utdanning, erfaring og eventuell vitenskapelig virksomhet
• Legg ved referanser, attester, vitnemål og annen dokumentasjon du mener er relevant. Hvis du har tatt en standardisert test som GRE eller GMAT, ber vi deg legge ved testresultatene.
• vitnemål med karakterutskrift som dokumenterer fullført mastergrad. Dersom du ikke har fullført mastergraden, skal du legge ved oppdatert karakterutskrift.
• Diploma Supplement eller tilsvarende dokumentasjon, samt konverteringsskala dersom dette er påkrevd
• dokumentasjon på engelskspråklig kompetanse dersom dette er påkrevd
• publikasjoner eller annet relevant forskningsarbeid
Dokumentasjonen må foreligge på et skandinavisk språk eller engelsk. 

Søknaden vurderes på grunnlag av informasjonen som er registrert i Jobbnorge ved søknadsfristen utløp. Sørg derfor for at søknaden tydelig viser hvordan din kompetanse og erfaring oppfyller kompetansekravene i utlysningen, og at nødvendig dokumentasjon er lastet opp. Dersom vedleggene samlet overskrider 100 MB, må filene komprimeres før opplasting.

UiS behandler bare søknader og vedlegg registrert i Jobbnorge.

Opplysninger om søkere kan bli offentliggjort selv om det er bedt om unntak fra offentlig søkerliste, jf. offentlighetsloven § 25. Dersom anmodningen ikke tas til følge, vil du bli varslet.
Ansettelsesvilkår og videre prosess
UiS er underlagt sikkerhetsloven, og det forventes at ansatte utviser sikkerhetsbevisst atferd, og følger gjeldende sikkerhets- og eksportkontrollrutiner. Ved ansettelse vil egenskaper som pålitelighet, dømmekraft og lojalitet bli vektlagt.

Ansettelse som stipendiat er regulert i universitets- og høgskoleforskriften kapittel IV. Opptak til doktorgradsutdanningen er regulert i forskrift for graden philosophiae doctor (ph.d.) ved Universitetet i Stavanger.

Dine kvalifikasjoner for stillingen vil bli vurdert av en intern komité på grunnlag av dokumentasjonen registrert i Jobbnorge ved søknadsfristens utløp. På bakgrunn av komiteens vurdering vil aktuelle søkere bli invitert til intervju. Det vil også bli innhentet referanser for aktuelle kandidater. Les mer om ansettelsesprosessen på våre nettsider.
 
Doktorgradsarbeidet skal i hovedsak gjennomføres ved Universitetet i Stavanger. Det er en forutsetning at den som ansettes bosetter seg slik at vedkommende kan være til stede og tilgjengelig for fagmiljøet i ordinær arbeidstid.

Stillingen er kunngjort på både norsk og engelsk. Ved eventuelle motstridende opplysninger mellom tekstene er det den norske teksten som legges til grunn.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Universitetet i Stavanger (UiS) har omlag 12.000 studenter og 1.900 ansatte. Universitetet har store ambisjoner. Vi skal ha en innovativ og internasjonal profil og være en drivkraft i kunnskapsutviklingen og endringsprosesser i samfunnet. Vår felles retning skal drives frem av omtanke for bærekraftig omstilling og rettferdig samfunnsutvikling, gjennom nye måter å forvalte naturressursene på og legge til rette for bedre byer og lokalsamfunn. Energi, helse og velferd, læring for livet er våre satsingsområder.I samspill og dialog med våre omgivelser regionalt, nasjonalt og internasjonalt har vi et åpent og innovativt klima for utdanning, forskning, kunstnerisk utviklingsarbeid, nyskapning, formidling og museumsvirksomhet.Den faglige virksomheten ved universitetet er organisert i seks fakultet med 13 institutt og to nasjonale forsknings- og kompetansesenter i tillegg til Arkeologisk museum. Vi er medlem i det europeiske nettverket for innovative universitet - European Consortium of Innovative Universities. Universitetet ligger i den mest attraktive regionen i landet med 300.000 innbyggere.  Stavangerregionen har et dynamisk arbeidsmarked og tilbyr en rekke spennende kultur- og fritidsaktiviteter.Sammen med våre ansatte og studenter vil vi løfte blikket, og våge å tenke stort og nytt – vi vil utfordre det velkjente og utforske det ukjente.

Handelshøgskolen UiS tilbyr bachelorutdanninger i økonomi og administrasjon og rettsvitenskap. I tillegg tilbys master i økonomi og administrasjon (siviløkonomutdanning), rettsvitenskap, regnskap og revisjon, erfarings-basert masterprogram rettet mot næringslivet (EMBA) samt forskerutdanning (PhD). Fakultetet legger til rette for utdanning, forskning og formidling innenfor en stor spennvidde av fag, som finans, markedsføring, organisasjon og ledelse, regnskap og revisjon, rettsvitenskap, strategi og økonomi. Universitetets Senter for innovasjonsforskning og Senter for entreprenørskap er organisatorisk plassert ved fakultetet. Pr i dag er omlag 120 ansatte og 1.400 studenter tilknyttet fakultetet. Handelshøgskolen ved UiS er organisert i tre avdelinger: Avdeling for innovasjon, ledelse og markedsføring, Avdeling for regnskap og rettsvitenskap og Avdeling for samfunnsøkonomi og finans.

jobs.occupation: Researcher / Postdoctoral Fellow in Microbial Ecology
jobs.employer_name: NORGES MILJØ- OG BIOVITENSKAPELIGE UNIVERSITET (NMBU) CAMPUS ÅS
jobs.description:
About the position
Do you want to take a leading role in turning a proven microbial concept into a scalable climate solution? At the Faculty of Chemistry, Biotechnology and Food Science, NMBU, we offer a three-year researcher/postdoc position in microbial ecology, starting in early 2027.

Agricultural soils are the largest human-made source of nitrous oxide (N₂O), a greenhouse gas almost 300 times more potent than CO₂. In a recent Nature paper, the Nitrogen group at NMBU showed that N₂O-reducing bacteria grown in biogas digestate can lower N₂O emissions from soil by 50–95%. This project, funded by the Grantham Foundation and the Platform for Agriculture + Climate Transformation, aims to make the approach cheap and widely applicable: we will design synthetic microbial communities (SynComs) that degrade crop residues such as straw and use them to fuel the growth of N₂O-reducing bacteria.

You will work alongside leading experts in the field. The Nitrogen group and the Microbial Ecology and Physiology group at NMBU have decades of experience in denitrification and N₂O biology and operate a robotized incubation system for high-resolution gas kinetics. 
 
The project leader brings expertise in the ecology of synthetic communities, and large-scale field trials and adaptation of the concept to US systems and substrates are run in close collaboration with Prof. Wendy Yang’s group at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign.

As the project’s lead experimentalist at NMBU, you will drive the lab work – from strain isolation to community assembly and N₂O measurements – with strong support from experienced colleagues. Large-scale production and field trials are carried out together with the wider team and parallel projects, giving your lab results a direct path to the field. You will also mentor students and have the opportunities to help shape new research directions and contribute to future funding applications.

This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career researcher to grow within a high-impact project and an experienced team. We look forward to your application!
Main tasks
The position is primarily experimental, and your responsibilities will include:

• Leading the isolation and characterization of bacterial strains that degrade complex plant polymers and enhance the growth yield of N₂O-reducing bacteria
• Designing and assembling synthetic microbial communities and testing them in microcosms
• Measuring N₂O reduction and assessing the performance of candidate communities
• Validating the best-performing communities in scaled-up cultivations
• Contributing lab results and expertise to field trials, including work with a field robot
• Mentoring master’s students and supporting the training of other team members
• Presenting results at international conferences and seminars
• Developing new research ideas and contributing to funding applications
• Leading and contributing to scientific publicationsCompetence
Required qualifications

• A PhD in microbiology, microbial ecology, biotechnology or a related field
• Documented wet-lab experience with bacterial isolation, characterization or cultivation
• Experience with independently planning and carrying out experimental research
• A strong publication record in international peer-reviewed journals, relative to career stage
• Good presentation skills, written and oral, in English
Qualifications considered an advantage

Experience with:

• Complex substrates such as straw or other plant biomass
• Isolation and characterization of bacteria
• DNA extraction from bacterial isolates
• Cultivation of microbial communities
• Denitrification, nitrogen cycling or anaerobic cultivation
• N₂O or other gas measurements
• Design and planning of wet-lab experiments
• Field trials
• Data analysis and bioinformatics 
Personal qualities

• Highly motivated and ambitious, with a high work capacity
• Analytical, with a strong ability to work independently and take initiative
• Ability to lead and coordinate practical research activities
• Good communication and collaboration skills
• Flexible and solution-oriented
Emphasis will be placed on personal suitability and on how the candidate’s experience fits the needs of the project. The overall assessment of qualifications will determine the ranking of applicants.
Remuneration and further information
The position is placed in position code 1109 Researcher (NOK 604900 – 966300) or 1352 Postdoctoral Fellow (NOK 604900 - 796600)depending on qualifications. For particularly well-qualified applicants, a higher salary may be considered. Appointment to a postdoctoral position aims to qualify for work in senior academic positions. 

A completed doctoral degree is required for appointment, and postdoctoral fellows are expected to participate in undergraduate teaching at NMBU. The position follows ordinary meriting regulations.
 
Interested in learning more about the position? Contact Prof. Åsa Frostegård, head of the research group, by phone at +4767232473  or by email at asa.frostegard@nmbu.no. 

General Information to applicants
Application
Send application electronically via the link "Apply for this job" at the top of this page. This will route you to the University's Web Recruitment System, where you will need to register an account (if you have not already) and log in before completing the online application form. 

Application Deadline: December 18, 2026

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge's CV form and not just included as an attachment. This is to be able to comply with the regulations in the Public Administration Act §15.
 
The following must be included in the application:

• Cover letter (max. 1 page), explaining your motivation for the position and how your experience fits the project. (please note that applications that lack a motivation letter clearly stating why the candidate is qualified and motivated for this particular project will be disregarded)
• Summary of research experience (max. 1 page), describing your most important research contributions and your own role in them.
• CV including a full publication list. 
• Up to five publications you consider most relevant to the position. 
• Copies of diplomas and other relevant certificates.
• Contact details for 2–3 references.
Applicants who are invited to an interview must be able to present certified copies of diplomas and certificates. 
About The Faculty of Chemistry, Biotechnology and Food Science
The Faculty of Chemistry, Biotechnology and Food Science (KBM) has about 180 employees, 80 PhD students and 500 BSc and MSc students. The faculty has 11 research groups within chemistry and biochemistry, microbiology and microbial gene technology, bioinformatics and data analysis, food science and nutrition. The Faculty has a state-of-the-art infrastructure for research and education: A biorefinery lab, proteomics platform, fermentation lab, a murine facility, platform for studies of microbial regulation of GHG release and a small-scale pilot plant for processing of food, incl. a microbrewery. Additionally, KBM has a strong competence in enzymology, fermentation and biorefining. KBM aims at a strong research position and collaborates in networks and research projects both nationally and internationally.  

For further information please follow this link: https://www.nmbu.no/en/faculty/kbm

We have the country's most satisfied university students, who receive research-based education in a unique student environment. Our graduates gain a high level of competence in interdisciplinary collaboration and are popular in the labor market.

NMBU has internationally leading research environments in several subjects. Together with our partners in society and business, we contribute to solving some of the biggest societal challenges of our time. We focus on innovation, communication and entrepreneurship because we believe these challenges are best solved with joint efforts. jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Fellow in restoration ecology
jobs.description:
Western Norway University of Applied Sciences (HVL) has a vacancy for a Postdoctoral Fellow in restoration ecology for a 3 year period
About the position:

We are looking for a highly motivated and talented postdoctoral fellow to join the Landscape, Ecology and Climate (LEC) research group at the Department of Civil Engineering and Environmental Sciences, at the Sogndal campus. The position is funded through the national, transdisciplinary research centre Landfutures, as part of its research area "Knowledge and worldviews". The Post Doc is a temporary, three-year position, but may be extended to four years with an additional year of teaching duties at the department. 

If you are interested in supporting sustainable land use by developing better prediction methods in restoration using advanced statistical modelling, and combine it with field work, this vacancy could be for you. 

The place of work for the position is campus Sogndal. 

Startingdate 01.05.2027
Key duties and responsibilities:
About Landfutures

Landfutures is an eight-year research centre for sustainable land and nature use (2026–2034), funded by the Research Council of Norway. The centre is led by Western Norway Research Institute and run jointly by Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, the Norwegian Mapping Authority, the Institute of Transport Economics, Nordland Research Institute, Ruralis Institute for Rural and Regional Research, the Norwegian Central Computing Centre and the Basque Centre for Climate Change in Spain. Landfutures aims to promote sustainable land use through transformative research and practice and intends to be a hub for research into profound societal changes in the way we use nature and land.

Background and research need

Sustainable land use acknowledges ecosystem restoration as a crucial strategy for halting biodiversity loss. Today, significant resources are invested in ecosystem restoration, yet our understanding of the long-term outcomes of restoration measures remains limited, partly due to insufficient monitoring and evaluation. 

 The Postdoctoral Fellow will explore methods for assessing restoration success of degraded ecosystems and supplement existing data from previous, long-term restoration studies with extra vegetation surveys. Emphasis will be placed on development of the ORBA (ordination regression-based analysis) approach. Concrete recommendations for how restoration projects can be monitored and evaluated shall be shared with practitioners. Ultimately, the work of the postdoctoral fellow will underpin evidence-based ecosystem restoration and contribute to Landfutures’ aim of strengthening sustainable land use and support well-functioning ecosystems.

Research environment

The postdoc fellow will be part of the LEC research group, an interdisciplinary group of ecologists and social scientists. We offer a stimulating, interdisciplinary academic environment. The postdoctoral  fellow will have their place of work and affiliation at campus Sogndal, and  work closely with the staff members of LEC, particularly Inger Auestad and Knut Rydgren.

The postdoctoral fellow will receive an annual stipend for conference participation, research visits, and equipment.

Through the transdisciplinary Landfutures centre, the postdoc will benefit from working with experts at the intersection of ecology, planning, political science, social anthropology and geography and in interaction with other Post Doc Fellows, PhD candidates and master’s students, as well as with relevant stakeholders. 
Qualifications:
Criteria for appointment to the position of postdoctoral fellow are regulated in Forskrift til universitets- og høyskoleloven.

Applicants must have earned a PhD in restoration ecology, vegetation ecology, or in a closely related field. Experience from botanical field work in Norwegian boreal ecosystems, and strong competence in floristics, including cryptogams, is mandatory. The candidate must have strong competence in (multivariate) statistical analyses and statistical modelling, particularly generalized linear models. A driver’s license is desirable. The applicant must have completed the PhD or have received confirmation of the date of defence before the application deadline

jobs.description:
About the position
At the Centre for Precision Psychiatry, Institute of Clinical Medicine, University of Oslo, we have two full-time 3-year Postdoctoral Research Fellowships available within Novo Nordisk Foundation (NNF) funded projects focused on uncovering mechanistic links between mid-life metabolic trajectories and late onset Alzheimer’s disease (AD).

These positions offer an exciting opportunity for highly motivated researchers to work at the interface of multi-omics, brain and body imaging, and artificial intelligence, contributing to a large-scale Norwegian, UK, and international biobank collaborations aimed at understanding how midlife metabolic dysfunction shifts the risk and timing of AD.

These NNF funded projects collectively aim to uncover the molecular mechanisms linking midlife metabolic trajectories to late-onset AD, and to translate these insights into a novel explainable AI-driven multimodal framework for personalized prediction. The project integrates multi-omics data (genetics, proteomics, metabolomics), brain and body MRI, cognitive assessments, and health registry-linked data from individuals across Norway and the UK.

The Centre for Precision Psychiatry has access to a rich and unique data infrastructure, including large databases of biomarkers, clinical and cognitive variables, genotyping and sequencing data, and MRI brain imaging data from patients with neuropsychiatric and severe mental disorders. In addition, the Centre actively collaborates with major international consortia, including the Psychiatric Genomics Consortium (PGC), the ENIGMA consortium, and the European Alzheimer’s Disease DNA BioBank (EADB). The research environment further benefits from access to data from a broad range of national and international studies, including Norwegian population cohorts (e.g., DemGene, HUSK, HUNT, Tromsø study, and MoBa), UK-based cohorts (EPIC-Norfolk, Fenland, and the UK Biobank), the Estonian Biobank, and the ABCD and ADNI studies.
 
The positions are primarily focused on the development and application of statistical and machine learning methods for integrating large-scale longitudinal multi-omics data (proteomics and metabolomics), with clinical and imaging data, and genetics from Norwegian and international biobanks. The postdoctoral fellows will contribute to the following activities: (1) identifying midlife metabolic trajectories that precede neurodegeneration and AD, including metabolic subtyping; (2) linking these trajectories to established neurodegeneration markers, brain and body MRI, and cognition; (3) characterizing gene x environment interactions that shape AD risk and timing; and (4) developing and validating the “AD Avatar” for predicting age of onset.

The successful candidates will work closely with an interdisciplinary research environment including statisticians, geneticists, clinicians, and data scientists, and will conduct research using state-of-the-art secure infrastructure, including the TSD platform at the University of Oslo.

These postdoctoral fellowships are intended to strengthen the candidate’s scientific independence and publication record, and to provide strong qualifications for future academic or research leadership positions within precision medicine, population health, and data-driven neuroscience.

For more information: https://www.med.uio.no/klinmed/english/research/centres/precision-psychiatry/
Main responsibilities
• Analyze and integrate large-scale multi-omics data (affinity-based proteomics and NMR- and mass spectrometry-based metabolomics) from Norwegian and international biobanks, applying time-to-event models and advanced statistical and machine learning methods
• Develop and validate longitudinal models of metabolic trajectories and age-dependent genetic and environmental effects using in-house tools such as FEMA-LONG, and contribute to open-source analytical pipelines
• Apply Mendelian randomization, mediation, colocalization, and genetic overlap analyses (e.g., MiXeR, conjFDR) to investigate causal links between metabolic dysfunction, cardiometabolic disease, and AD-related outcomes
• Contribute to the development of the explainable “AD Avatar” predictive framework, including federated learning across Norwegian and UK-based data infrastructures (TSD, Tryggve, UKB-RAP)
• Collaborate with an interdisciplinary team and international partners in the UK, Sweden, Denmark, Iceland, Estonia, and the USA.
• Prepare and publish high-quality scientific manuscripts and present findings at national and international conferencesQualifications
Required

• A PhD in statistics, mathematics, informatics, genetics, medicine, psychology, or an equivalent field
• Strong programming skills in Python, R, or MATLAB, with emphasis on data analysis and method development
• Solid experience in statistical analysis and data processing using relevant statistical software
• Experience with large-scale human datasets, including multi-omics and/or imaging data
• Experience with tools and pipelines for genetic data analysis (e.g., PLINK, Regenie)
• Excellent proficiency in written and spoken English 
Preferred

• Experience with molecular quantitative trait loci studies, integrating NMR-based metabolomics (Nightingale) or mass spectrometry (Metabolon, Biocrates), and/or affinity-based proteomics data (SomaScan, Olink) with genetic data
• Experience with machine learning for large multimodal datasets and brain image analysis (e.g., FreeSurfer, FSL)
• Experience with computational methods and workflows for handling large-scale multimodal data
• Experience with survival analysis, longitudinal mixed-effects modelling, or clinical risk predictionPersonal skills

• Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary research teams.

jobs.description:
Trade a life of hustle and bustle for a summer in the Norwegian fjords and mountains. Meet guests from around the world, join our friendly international team and gain valuable experience while exploring spectacular landscapes, small communities and some of Norway’s most beautiful destinations.

Hva vi ser etter
Who We Are Looking For

If you are curious, service focussed, reliable and enjoy working closely amongst a team of individuals who enjoy connecting with people and working in a dynamic environment, then we are very interested in talking to you.

Requirements:

• 

Fluency in English and at least one, of the following languages: German, Spanish, Italian, French, Norwegian, Dutch or Chinese. Portuguese can also be an advantage. Proficiency in two or more of these languages in addition to English is considered a strong advantage.

• 

If you are not a Norwegian citizen, you must be an EU/EEA citizen or already have a valid Norwegian work permit.

• 

Interest in Norwegian history, culture, and nature.

• 

Guide Certification (or willingness to obtain one).

• 

Strong and demonstrable verbal communication skills are a huge advantage

• 

An experienced team player

Not Certified Yet?

As a part of our quality guarantee to our clients, our guides must hold at minimum a Guide Certification ensuring high professional standards. Several certification options are available in Norway.

We work together with and recommend the Guide Academy Certification Programme , which includes an engaging online course (completed remotely) and an intensive on-site training session in Voss starting April the 12th 2027.

No prior guiding experience is required, only passion and enthusiasm!

We sponsor the certification fee for candidates who commit to working a full season exclusively with Voss og Fjordane Guideservice.

Arbeidsoppgaver

What is working as a Guide in the Voss area like?

As a Tour Guide, you'll lead guests through some of Western Norway's most spectacular fjord and mountain landscapes.

Assignments range from scenic coach and fjord tours to ferry excursions, walking tours and hikes. You'll lead groups of up to 50 guests, share local stories and culture, and take responsibility for creating a safe, engaging and memorable experience.

The job is dynamic: schedules can change, and some tours will be repeated throughout the season. But every group is different, and there are also opportunities to work from other ports and experience more of Western Norway.

Vi tilbyr
What We Offer

• 

An international job in the heart of Fjord Norway - Experience a more authentic side of Norway, living and working among fjords, mountains, traditional villages and small local communities. Voss gives you a quieter base close to nature, while your assignments take you through some of Western Norway's most attractive destinations.

• 

A seasonal job with variety - Most assignments take place between May and mid-October, with additional guiding opportunities from April and into the later part of the year.

• 

Guaranteed minimum seasonal income - More predictability while still retaining the variety and flexibility that comes with guiding.

• 

Professional training and certification sponsorship - We'll help you gain professional qualifications and can sponsor your Guide Certification, including visits to destinations and venues throughout the region when you commit to a full season with us .

• 

Fair working conditions - We focus on creating a sustainable, inclusive and positive working environment. We provide full paid training on company specific procedures, tour logistics and guest service standards,

• 

Explore more of Fjord Norway - Your workplace extends far beyond Voss, with opportunities to guide in Flåm, Eidfjord, Ulvik, Vik, Odda, Rosendal and other destinations across the region. Assignments outside our normal region come with higher pay and paid travel time.

• 

Opportunities to grow - Guiding can be a first step into a wider career in tourism, hospitality and destination development.

Support with finding accommodation

Moving to Voss? We help make the move easier by arranging accommodation for most of our seasonal guides. This is subject to availability and at the guide's own expense. We can also provide guidance if you prefer to find your own place.

Om arbeidsgiveren:
About Voss og Fjordane Guide Service

The first official private guide service in Norway, with over 38 years of experience, Voss og fjordane Guideservice has a team of over 40 guides dedicated to creating exciting and meaningful experiences for guests visiting the fjord and mountain region of Western Norway.

Our philosophy is simple: when our guides are enthused, our guests will be as well -- enthusiasm is, after all, contagious! We spend much time developing and nurturing our team, ensuring that each guide can be a trusted leader, an exciting storyteller, a proud ambassador of the fjord region culture and a collaborative and engaging team member.

We deliver over 3,000 assignments every year, collaborating with over 90% of the cruise calls in some of the most beautiful cruise destinations in the country.

Our aim is to be the best we can be, and to get better every day!

jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Engineer for an assignment with one of our clients within the subsea and energy industry.

 

The position combines mechanical design with technical project responsibility. You will be responsible for engineering activities in projects involving standard and customized products, from design and planning through fabrication, assembly and testing.

 

The assignment is based in Bergen, with office-based work five days per week. Some travel to the client’s production and testing facility should be expected.

 

Responsibilities:

• Lead and coordinate engineering activities in projects involving standard and customized products.
• Design metering systems and related mechanical equipment.
• Take responsibility for the engineering scope throughout project execution.
• Develop and maintain engineering plans and ensure progress against project schedules.
• Coordinate engineering activities and resources in cooperation with the Project Manager.
• Develop 3D CAD models of components and complete systems.
• Prepare fabrication documentation, engineering drawings and procedures.
• Perform internal and external design reviews.
• Review and approve engineering drawings and technical documentation.
• Follow up components, sub-suppliers, fabrication and production activities as required.
• Support assembly and testing activities at the production facility.
• Participate in equipment testing when required.
• Support the Project Manager with engineering expertise and technical input.
• Participate in client meetings where technical expertise is required.
• Ensure designs comply with relevant industry standards, safety requirements, regulations and client specifications.
• Identify opportunities for technical improvements and cost-efficient solutions.
• Coordinate independently with relevant stakeholders, including suppliers, clients, project management and engineering disciplines.
• Ensure high standards of HSE, quality and engineering practice throughout project execution.
 

Qualifications:

• BSc or MSc within Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Design or a related discipline.
• Minimum 5 years of relevant experience within mechanical design and project execution.
• Experience with Creo or an equivalent 3D CAD system is essential.
• Experience with Teamcenter is highly preferred.
• Experience from subsea, oil & gas, offshore or other technically complex industries is preferred.
• Experience with metering and measurement systems is considered an advantage.
• Experience working with mechanical systems, equipment integration, fabrication and testing.
• Experience coordinating engineering activities within projects.
• Good understanding of engineering documentation and manufacturing drawings.
• Good written and spoken English.
 

Personal skills:

• Proactive and self-driven, with the ability to take ownership of engineering activities from planning through delivery.
• Structured and solution-oriented, with a strong focus on quality and deadlines.
• Confident in making technical decisions based on engineering data, experience and risk assessment.
• Able to balance technical requirements, cost and schedule considerations.
• Strong communication skills and comfortable working with clients, suppliers and multidisciplinary project teams.
• Collaborative and able to coordinate effectively across engineering, project management, production and testing.
• Practical and hands-on in your approach, with an interest in following the product from engineering through assembly and testing.
• Comfortable working independently and taking responsibility for progress within your area.

Om stillingen
Universitetet i Stavanger har ledig stilling som stipendiat i fødererte blokkjedeteknologier ved Det teknisk- naturvitenskapelige fakultet , Institutt for data- og elektroteknologi. Stillingen er ledig fra våren 2027.

Den som ansettes tas opp på doktorgradsprogrammet i teknologi og naturvitenskap. Programmet omfatter blant annet selvstendig forskningsarbeid, deltakelse i nasjonale og internasjonale forskermiljø samt forskningsformidling. Les mer om forskerutdanningen ved UiS på våre nettsider.

Stillingen er for tre år med ren forskerutdanning eller fire år med forskerutdanning kombinert med annet karrierefremmende arbeid. Dette avklares i rekrutteringsprosessen.

Som stipendiat ved UiS får du støtte til faglig og karrieremessig utvikling gjennom veiledning, kompetanseutvikling og karriereplanlegging.

Den som ansettes vil være tilknyttet forskningsprosjektet «fødererte blokkjedeteknologier», som befinner seg i skjæringspunktet mellom blokkjede, nettsky og distribuert resonnering. Det fokuserer på tre områder:

• Hvordan kan vi støtte ingeniører i å sømløst kombinere blokkjede og distribuert databehandling for å håndtere automatiserte arbeidsflyter på tvers av fødererte noder? 
• Hvordan kan man verifisere beregningsoppgaver som utføres av ressurser styrt av smarte kontrakter, på tvers av noder i en føderasjon? 
• Hvordan kan man utforme en effektiv blokkjede for fødererte tjenester?

Dette miljøet gir en unik mulighet til å kombinere banebrytende blokkjede utforminger og tjenester med relevante anvendelser.

Fødererte blokkjedetjenester gjør det mulig for organisasjoner å dele tokeniserte ressurser – som data, KI-modeller og regnekraft – på tvers av juridiske og nasjonale grenser uten å være avhengige av én sentral myndighet. Etter hvert som databehandling utvides fra skyen til enheter i nettverkets ytterkant (edge) og tingenes internett, forbedrer dette prosjektet eksisterende systemer ved å bruke automatiserte KI-agenter, desentraliserte identifikatorer og smarte kontrakter for å håndtere delte ressurser på en trygg måte. 
 
Dette samarbeidsnettverket er bygget på den europeiske blokkjedeinfrastrukturen (EBSI) og sikrer trygg, etterprøvbar datadeling i fullt samsvar med EUs regelverk for kryptoeiendeler (MiCA). Det lar hver deltakende enhet opprettholde finjustert kontroll over sine digitale aktiva samtidig som de deler beregningsresultater ved hjelp av disse aktivaene, med følgende viktige komponenter som skal utforskes:

1) Sikker og prosessorientert sammensetning av digitale aktiva og tjenester på tvers av organisasjoner; 2) Sikker og kvalitetssikret tjenesteoppdagelse, integrasjon og automatisering; 3) Pålitelig, adaptiv og kvalitetssikret testing av forretningsapplikasjoner; 4) Automatisk samsvarsvalidering og overvinnelse av barrierer. 

Det foreslåtte økosystemet vil øke konkurranseevnen og kapasiteten for automatisert databehandling i en føderasjon. Integrering og validering av banebrytende teknologier vil gi forbedringer i cybersamarbeid for applikasjoner distribuert i heterogene infrastrukturer. Ved å integrere etiske aspekter i et menneskeorientert design, kan sømløst samarbeid mellom mennesker og databehandlingssystemer realiseres
Kvalifikasjoner
Du må ha en sterk faglig bakgrunn med femårig mastergrad innenfor informatikk, databehandling, eller tilsvarende utdanning som gir grunnlag for å gjennomføre en forskerutdanning, fortrinnsvis av nyere dato.

Karakter på masteroppgaven og veid gjennomsnittskarakter for masterstudiet må begge tilsvare B eller bedre. 

Dersom du har utdanning fra en institusjon med annen karakterskala enn A-F, ber vi deg legge ved dokumentasjon som viser hvordan karakterene kan sammenliknes med den norske karakterskalaen. Du kan bruke disse konverteringsskalaene til å beregne poengene dine for opptak.

Dersom du fullfører mastergraden våren 2027, er du også velkommen til å søke.

• kunnskap om nettsky-teknologier, blokkjede-teknologier og/eller distribuerte tjenester
• interesse for tverrfaglig forskning om systemer som kombinerer hardware-software i design
Vi legger også vekt på at du:

• er nysgjerrig og motivert for å gjennomføre forskningsprosjektet og bidra til faglige fellesskap og samarbeid på tvers av fagområder

Universitetet ligger i den mest attraktive regionen i landet med 300.000 innbyggere.  Stavangerregionen har et dynamisk arbeidsmarked og tilbyr en rekke spennende kultur- og fritidsaktiviteter.Sammen med våre ansatte og studenter vil vi løfte blikket, og våge å tenke stort og nytt – vi vil utfordre det velkjente og utforske det ukjente.

Det teknisk-naturvitenskapelige fakultet tilbyr utdanninger på bachelor-, master- og doktorgradsnivå. Fakultetet har sterke bånd til både forskningsinstitusjoner og industri. Nesten 40 % av budsjettet er eksternt finansiert. Studentene våre har tett kontakt med næringslivet, og mange master- og doktorgradsoppgaver blir skrevet i samarbeid med industrien. Fakultetet har etablert forskningssamarbeid med universiteter over hele verden, og har flere fagmiljø som er internasjonalt ledende. Fakultetet har om lag 3000 studenter og rundt 500 ansatte fordelt på fakultetsadministrasjonen og seks institutt: institutt for data- og elektroteknikk, institutt for maskin, bygg og materialteknologi, institutt for matematikk og fysikk, institutt for kjemi, biovitenskap og miljøteknologi, institutt for energi- og petroleumsteknologi og institutt for sikkerhet, økonomi og planlegging. Institutt for data- og elektroteknologi driver forskning innen datateknologi, data science, kybernetikk, elkraft, signalbehandling og medisinsk teknologi. Instituttet er også vert for forskningsnettverket Stavanger AI Lab, og tilbyr bachelor- og masterutdanninger i elektroteknikk, datateknologi, data science, kybernetikk, kunstig intelligens og medisinsk teknologi. I tillegg tilbys ph.d.-utdanning i de samme fagområdene.

jobs.occupation: Field Application Engineer
jobs.description:
At Six Robotics, we build intelligent software that gives Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) the ability to collaborate, adapt on the fly, and execute missions that were previously impossible. From our base in Oslo, our 70+ experts in defence, software, and AI develop our flagship autonomy and swarm platform used by both government and industry. In close partnership with the Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (FFI), we move fast from concept to live deployment, often in the field alongside end users.

We work with advanced hardware and software, a modern tech stack, and missions that demand both technical mastery and operational discipline. Everyone is close to the action, from deep technical problem-solving to field operations. We move fast and value clarity, integrity, and teamwork in everything we do.

At Six Robotics, every person executes with precision, adapts to changing conditions, and strengthens the team. We only hire the best. Getting in is hard, and you’ll be challenged every day. But if you have the skill, the discipline, and the drive to push your limits, you’ll find no better place to deliver real-world impact while collaborating and learning from the best in the field.

About the role
We’re scaling fast, and to meet growing demand from both customers and internal teams, we’re expanding our Field Application Engineering team. Today, we are seven engineers split into two focused units: one driving internal testing and system validation, the other leading customer-facing work like demos, onboarding, and training. Together, this team is responsible for one thing above all else: making sure our technical works where it actually matters.

As a Field Application Engineer at Six Robotics, you sit at the intersection of product, engineering, and operators. You’ll take cutting-edge autonomy software out into the field, where constraints are real, stakes are high, and feedback is immediate. What you learn in the field directly shapes what we build next.

The role requires extensive travel (approximately 150 days per year), both nationally and internationally. This is not a desk role. You will spend most of your time in the field, working side-by-side with operators, testing systems under real conditions, troubleshooting when things don’t go as planned, and making sure every deployment delivers real operational value.

What you will do
• 
Own customer integrations: take part in technical pre-sales, lead onboarding, capture requirements, and ensure our swarm software is seamlessly integrated and fully operational.

• 
Turn needs into plans: create integration steps, checklists, and test procedures that guide both customers and our teams.

• 
Run field tests: plan and execute acceptance tests and trials, analyze telemetry, and feed results back into product and engineering.

• 
Troubleshoot issues: diagnose and resolve problems across hardware, firmware, networking, and software, often in time-critical situations.

• 
Deliver customer demos: plan and execute high-quality demos that communicate the value of our technology to customers and partners.

• 
Train and onboarding users: ensure operators understand how to use our systems effectively through structured training and hands-on support.

• 
Document and scale: build playbooks, runbooks, and internal best practices to support customers and future field engineers.

• 
Be the technical face in the field: act as the bridge between customers, operators, and internal teams, ensuring alignment and continuous improvement.

What we are looking for
We’re looking for a Field Application Engineer who is as comfortable in front of people as they are working hands-on with complex systems in the field. You are outgoing, robust, and adaptable, someone who thrives in dynamic environments where plans change and challenges arise. You bring structure to complexity, communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and take ownership from problem to solution.

You’re a creative problem solver who isn’t afraid to get your hands dirty, whether that means debugging systems in the field, setting up hardware, or working through unexpected issues under pressure. At the same time, you are confident in explaining complex concepts, building customer trust, and representing Six Robotics externally.

To be a strong fit for the role, we believe you:

• 
Have a strong technical foundation: ability to set up, configure, and troubleshoot complex systems across networking, hardware, and software.

• 
Are structured and reliable: capable of managing multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and field activities without losing clarity or momentum.

• 
Is an excellent communicator: able to explain complex technical concepts to operators, customers, and internal teams.

• 
Are hands-on and proactive: you take initiative, solve problems end-to-end, and are comfortable working directly with hardware and systems in the field.

• 
Are willing to travel extensively: able and motivated to spend around 150 days per year in the field, both nationally and internationally.

• 
Are fluent in English; Norwegian is a strong advantage. German or French is a plus.

In addition to the above, experience with UAVs, robotics, defence, or similar complex systems would be valuable. Familiarity with military organizations or prior field-based, customer-facing technical work is a plus. Basic programming skills or the ability to read code would also be beneficial.

Why you should join
At Six Robotics, we build systems that work when it matters the most. If you're driven by meaningful problems, technical depth, and the chance to shape something from the ground up, you'll find your place here.

• 
Contribute to a mission with urgency: Help build autonomy that protects nations and deters conflict in an era defined by unmanned warfare. The problems are real, the stakes are high, and the need is now.

• 
Take ownership from day one: You’ll be trusted with real responsibility early, with the autonomy to move fast and solve hard problems without unnecessary layers.

• 
Build from zero, shape the future: Join early and help shape the systems, tools, and ways of working as we scale. What you build is used in real operations, with a short and clear feedback loop between your work and its impact.

• 
Work with purpose, supported by great benefits: Be part of a team of smart, driven, and engaged individuals who take pride in their work and push each other to improve. We offer competitive compensation, equity potential, and solid insurance and pension plans.

Our recruitment process
We aim to keep our process short and sweet, but also thorough. As a small team, every hire matters, and we can’t afford to get this one wrong.

Here’s what to expect:

• 
Screening interview with one of our recruiters to get to know you better (30 min).

• 
Meet & Greet with someone from the team to get to know each other better (60 min).

• 
Structured case interview to understand role fit and potential (90 min).

• 
Final interview with Head of People to assess cultural fit (45 min).

• 
Reference check followed by an offer if everything goes well.

We will review applications on an ongoing basis.

All employees at Six Robotics are required to undergo a security clearance (Sikkerhetsklarering) due to our close collaboration with the Norwegian Armed Forces. Prior clearance is not required; the process begins as part of onboarding. As part of this process, eligibility is limited to candidates holding citizenship from EU and NATO member countries.

Om arbeidsgiveren:
We exist to strengthen defence, protect nations, and deter conflict in an era defined by unmanned warfare. Our mission is to multiply operational capabilities, accelerate the transition to robotic warfare, and give NATO and our allies a decisive advantage in the new era of unmanned operations.

We overcome the limits of current systems with collaborative swarm autonomy, enabling unmanned systems to act as one. Our software lets drones collaborate, adapt, and execute missions as a team, allowing a single operator to control an army of robots, accelerate decisions, and multiply combat effectiveness.
